def require(condition: bool, message: str) -> None:
    """Stop with a precise error when a bound evidence contract is violated."""
    if not condition:
        raise SystemExit(f"evidence binding failed: {message}")


def sha_raw(path: Path) -> str:
    """Return SHA-256 over exact file bytes."""
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def sha_lf(path: Path) -> str:
    """Return SHA-256 after CRLF-to-LF normalization, matching the driver."""
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes().replace(b"\r\n", b"\n")).hexdigest()


def load_json(path: Path) -> dict[str, object]:
    """Read a JSON object and reject any other root value."""
    value = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    require(isinstance(value, dict), f"expected JSON object: {path}")
    return value


def hash_map(paths: list[str], root: Path, *, normalized: bool) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Hash every required path and fail on missing inputs."""
    result: dict[str, str] = {}
    for relative in paths:
        path = root / relative
        require(path.is_file(), f"missing bound input: {path}")
        result[relative] = sha_lf(path) if normalized else sha_raw(path)
    return result


def python_sources(export: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Recreate the frozen driver's complete Python source inventory."""
    result = {
        path.relative_to(export).as_posix(): sha_lf(path)
        for prefix in ("apps", "core", "shared", "scripts", "qmt_agent", "sdk", "tests")
        for path in (export / prefix).rglob("*.py")
        if "__pycache__" not in path.parts
    }
    result.update({path.name: sha_lf(path) for path in export.glob("*.py")})
    return result


def tracked_inputs(export: Path, expected: dict[str, object]) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Hash frozen Git inputs, excluding only generated module_map.json."""
    result: dict[str, str] = {}
    for relative in expected:
        require(relative != "governance/module_map.json", "generated module map is not a tracked-input comparison")
        path = export / relative
        require(path.is_file(), f"missing tracked source input: {relative}")
        result[relative] = sha_raw(path)
    return result


def display_path(path: Path) -> str:
    """Use a repo-relative path where available, otherwise an absolute path."""
    resolved = path.resolve()
    try:
        return resolved.relative_to(ROOT.resolve()).as_posix()
    except ValueError:
        return resolved.as_posix()


def evidence_hash(path: Path, evidence: dict[str, dict[str, str]]) -> None:
    """Require an evidence file and record raw and normalized digests."""
    require(path.is_file(), f"missing evidence file: {path}")
    data = path.read_bytes()
    evidence[display_path(path)] = {
        "sha256_raw": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),
        "sha256_lf": hashlib.sha256(data.replace(b"\r\n", b"\n")).hexdigest(),
    }


def git_bytes(*args: str) -> bytes:
    """Read immutable source-tree evidence from the local Git object database."""
    return subprocess.check_output(["git", "-c", "core.safecrlf=false", *args], cwd=ROOT)


def junit_summary(
    label: str,
    record: dict[str, object],
    export: Path,
    evidence: dict[str, dict[str, str]],
) -> dict[str, object]:
    """Verify JUnit counts, requested suites, and exact backend skips."""
    require(set(record) == {"passed", "skipped", "junit"}, f"unexpected pytest record fields: {label}")
    expected_path = export / ".tmp" / f"{PREFIX}-{label}-junit.xml"
    actual_value = record.get("junit")
    require(isinstance(actual_value, str), f"missing JUnit path for {label}")
    actual_path = Path(actual_value)
    require(actual_path.resolve() == expected_path.resolve(), f"unexpected JUnit path for {label}")
    evidence_hash(actual_path, evidence)
    root = ET.parse(actual_path).getroot()
    cases = [node for node in root.iter() if node.tag.rsplit("}", 1)[-1] == "testcase"]
    require(bool(cases), f"JUnit has no testcases: {label}")
    failures = [case for case in cases if any(child.tag.rsplit("}", 1)[-1] in {"failure", "error"} for child in case)]
    require(not failures, f"JUnit includes failures/errors: {label}")
    skipped_cases = [case for case in cases if any(child.tag.rsplit("}", 1)[-1] == "skipped" for child in case)]
    skipped_names = [case.attrib.get("name", "") for case in skipped_cases]
    require(all(skipped_names), f"unnamed skip in JUnit: {label}")
    require(len(skipped_names) == len(set(skipped_names)), f"duplicate skipped case name: {label}")
    skipped = set(skipped_names)
    if label == "unit-coverage":
        expected_skips: set[str] = set()
        requested = UNITS
    elif label == "sqlite-component":
        expected_skips = PG_ONLY
        requested = COMPONENTS
    elif label == "native-component":
        expected_skips = set()
        requested = COMPONENTS
    else:
        raise SystemExit(f"evidence binding failed: unexpected JUnit label {label}")
    require(skipped == expected_skips, f"unexpected skips for {label}: {sorted(skipped)}")
    reported_skips = record.get("skipped")
    require(isinstance(reported_skips, list) and reported_skips == sorted(skipped), f"JUnit/result JSON skip mismatch: {label}")
    passed = len(cases) - len(skipped_cases)
    require(passed > 0, f"no passing tests in {label}")
    require(type(record.get("passed")) is int and record["passed"] == passed, f"passed count mismatch: {label}")
    classes = {case.attrib.get("classname", "") for case in cases if case not in skipped_cases}
    for path in requested:
        suffix = path.removesuffix(".py").replace("/", ".")
        require(any(name.endswith(suffix) for name in classes), f"JUnit omitted requested module {path}")
    if label == "native-component":
        names = {case.attrib.get("name", "") for case in cases}
        require(PG_ONLY <= names, "native JUnit omitted a PostgreSQL concurrency case")
        require(not (PG_ONLY & skipped), "native JUnit skipped a required PostgreSQL concurrency case")
    return {"passed": passed, "skipped": sorted(skipped), "total": len(cases), "junit_path": display_path(actual_path)}

"""Reject application networking; allow two exact installed local wakeup routines."""

import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
import socket
import sys

_attempts = []
_cpython_pairs = 0
_twisted_pairs = 0
_original_connect = socket.socket.connect
_socketpair_code = socket.socketpair.__code__
_twisted_source_sha256 = "7d4a3d61108985df4afa3354d5ba88dccef5fa3945478b0eac4d6a7d87ade360"
_verified_twisted_code = None


def _blocked(*args, **kwargs):
    _attempts.append(True)
    raise AssertionError("Application connection or DNS lookup forbidden in isolated Domain checks")


def _exact_twisted_waker(frame, sock, address):
    global _verified_twisted_code
    module = sys.modules.get("twisted.internet._signals")
    if module is None:
        return False
    klass = vars(module).get("_SocketWaker")
    if klass is None or frame.f_code is not klass.__init__.__code__:
        return False
    server = frame.f_locals.get("server")
    if (frame.f_locals.get("client") is not sock
            or type(server) is not socket.socket
            or type(sock) is not socket.socket
            or server.family != socket.AF_INET
            or sock.family != socket.AF_INET
            or address != server.getsockname()
            or address[0] != "127.0.0.1"
            or server.getsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_ACCEPTCONN) != 1):
        return False
    if _verified_twisted_code is None:
        source = Path(module.__file__)
        assert hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == _twisted_source_sha256
        _verified_twisted_code = klass.__init__.__code__
    return frame.f_code is _verified_twisted_code


def _connect(sock, address):
    global _cpython_pairs, _twisted_pairs
    frame = sys._getframe(1)
    if (frame.f_code is _socketpair_code
            and frame.f_locals.get("csock") is sock
            and address == (frame.f_locals.get("addr"), frame.f_locals.get("port"))
            and address[0] in {"127.0.0.1", "::1"}):
        _cpython_pairs += 1
        return _original_connect(sock, address)
    if _exact_twisted_waker(frame, sock, address):
        _twisted_pairs += 1
        return _original_connect(sock, address)
    return _blocked(sock, address)


socket.socket.connect = _connect
socket.socket.connect_ex = _blocked
socket.socket.sendto = _blocked
socket.getaddrinfo = _blocked
socket.gethostbyname = _blocked
socket.gethostbyname_ex = _blocked
socket.gethostbyaddr = _blocked


def pytest_sessionfinish(session, exitstatus):
    print("Rejected application socket/DNS attempts:", len(_attempts))
    print("Exact internal CPython/Twisted wakeup pairs:", _cpython_pairs, _twisted_pairs)
    if _attempts:
        session.exitstatus = 1

def require(ok: bool, reason: str) -> None:
    """Stop if an acceptance input differs from the reviewed contract."""
    if not ok:
        raise SystemExit(f"settlement acceptance stopped: {reason}")


def sha(data: bytes) -> str:
    """Return a raw SHA-256 digest."""
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def sha_lf(data: bytes) -> str:
    """Return SHA-256 after checkout CRLF normalization."""
    return sha(data.replace(b"\r\n", b"\n"))


def git(*args: str, env: dict[str, str] | None = None, data: bytes | None = None) -> bytes:
    """Read Git evidence; optional index operations are isolated under .tmp."""
    return subprocess.check_output(
        ["git", "-c", "core.safecrlf=false", *args], cwd=ROOT, env=env, input=data
    )


def load(path: Path) -> dict[str, object]:
    """Load one UTF-8 JSON object."""
    value = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    require(isinstance(value, dict), f"expected JSON object: {path}")
    return value


def evidence_name(path: Path) -> str:
    """Use root-relative paths for local artifacts and absolute export paths."""
    try:
        return path.resolve().relative_to(ROOT.resolve()).as_posix()
    except ValueError:
        return path.resolve().as_posix()


def frozen_patch(reference: dict[str, object]) -> bytes:
    """Rebuild the exact three-production-file tree through a private Git index."""
    require(git("rev-parse", "HEAD").decode().strip() == BASE, "checkout is not at frozen base")
    require(reference.get("base_commit") == BASE, "reference base differs")
    require(reference.get("source_tree") == SOURCE_TREE, "reference tree differs")
    require(reference.get("source_commit") == SOURCE_COMMIT, "reference commit differs")
    require(reference.get("production") == PRODUCTION, "production path list differs")
    require(reference.get("source_lf_sha256") == SOURCE_LF, "source LF hashes differ")
    require(set(git("diff", "--name-only", BASE, SOURCE_TREE).decode().splitlines()) == set(PRODUCTION), "frozen tree changes other paths")
    require(git("rev-parse", f"{SOURCE_COMMIT}^{{tree}}").decode().strip() == SOURCE_TREE, "frozen commit tree differs")
    require(git("rev-list", "--parents", "-n", "1", SOURCE_COMMIT).decode().split() == [SOURCE_COMMIT, BASE], "frozen commit parent differs")
    require(INDEX.parent.resolve() == (ROOT / ".tmp").resolve() and not INDEX.exists(), "private Git index target is unsafe or occupied")
    patch = git("diff", "--binary", BASE, SOURCE_TREE)
    env = dict(os.environ, GIT_INDEX_FILE=str(INDEX))
    try:
        git("read-tree", BASE, env=env)
        git("apply", "--cached", "--binary", "-", env=env, data=patch)
        require(git("write-tree", env=env).decode().strip() == SOURCE_TREE, "patch did not recreate source tree")
    finally:
        if INDEX.exists():
            require(INDEX.resolve().parent == (ROOT / ".tmp").resolve(), "index cleanup escaped .tmp")
            INDEX.unlink()
    for path, digest in SOURCE_LF.items():
        require(sha_lf((ROOT / path).read_bytes()) == digest, f"live source hash differs: {path}")
    return patch


def embed_phase_evidence(summary: dict[str, object], reference: dict[str, object]) -> dict[str, dict[str, object]]:
    """Embed the binder-listed logs and evidence while keeping secrets hash-only."""
    evidence = summary.get("evidence_files")
    private_hashes = reference.get("private_inputs_raw_sha256")
    require(isinstance(evidence, dict) and isinstance(private_hashes, dict), "evidence inventory is missing")
    require(SENSITIVE_INPUTS <= set(private_hashes), "reference does not bind all sensitive inputs")
    assets: dict[str, dict[str, object]] = {}
    for name, hashes in evidence.items():
        normalized = str(name).replace("\\", "/")
        require(not any(normalized.endswith(item) for item in SENSITIVE_INPUTS), "raw settings/env/runtime content cannot be embedded")
        path = Path(str(name))
        if not path.is_absolute():
            path = ROOT / path
        require(path.is_file() and isinstance(hashes, dict), f"evidence file is absent: {name}")
        raw = path.read_bytes()
        require(hashes.get("sha256_raw") == sha(raw) and hashes.get("sha256_lf") == sha_lf(raw), f"evidence hash mismatch: {name}")
        assets[str(name)] = {
            "sha256_raw": sha(raw),
            "sha256_lf": sha_lf(raw),
            "content_base64": base64.b64encode(raw).decode("ascii"),
        }
    return assets

    require(identity.get("base_commit") == BASE and identity.get("source_tree") == SOURCE_TREE, "summary source identity differs")
    require(identity.get("source_commit") == SOURCE_COMMIT, "summary commit differs")

    immutability = summary.get("input_immutability")
    require(isinstance(immutability, dict) and immutability and all(value is True for value in immutability.values()), "an input immutability check failed")

    tests = summary.get("pytest_actual_counts")

    unit, sqlite, native = tests["unit-coverage"], tests["sqlite-component"], tests["native-component"]

    coverage = summary.get("domain_coverage_percent_by_file")

    require(isinstance(retirement, dict) and retirement.get("actual_exit_code") == 1 and retirement.get("green") is False and retirement.get("known_violation_count") == 9, "retirement exit must remain non-green")
    return {"pytest_actual_counts": tests, "coverage": coverage, "governance": governance}
